name: Flip the bits
description: Set binary switches to make a number, unsigned or two's complement. A fresh target every review; graded exactly.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Optional line shown under the number (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: target
fields.description: A fixed target. Empty: a new one every review.

fields.name: showTotal
fields.description: Show the running decimal and hex while flipping (easier).
